visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit modern office with blue dividers. A woman with her hair in a bun wearing a dark sweater sits at her desk. A man in a black t-shirt approaches and places a small rectangular box on her desk. She reacts with an exaggerated expression of feigned annoyance, which quickly turns into a boastful smile as she looks at the camera. A group of four colleagues—two men and two women—immediately cluster around her, leaning in with wide eyes and open mouths, gesturing with their hands to show excitement. (2) After a jump cut, a different woman with short, brownish hair is seated at the same desk. A man’s hand enters the frame and delivers a red card. She holds it up with a confused but curious expression. The same group of colleagues gathers again, looking over her shoulder. One woman in a yellow shirt leans in closely. They all point at a card inside the envelope and laugh boisterously, with one woman clutching her face in mock romantic shock. (3) The scene shifts to a third woman with long blonde braids wearing a light yellow sweater. She gestures toward someone off-camera. A man delivers a white shopping bag. She pulls out a piece of white lace lingerie. The surrounding group of colleagues reacts with physical recoiling, twisting their faces into expressions of disgust and 'ew' gestures. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the office setting.
